headline: Draft city rules for body works establishments presented, with public hearing possibly in December
summary: The draft sets out what body works businesses can and can't do, such as reflexology. It responds to problems with illicit massage businesses, and the police department worked with the city on some of these issues. The public hearing may be in December, and the board is to review the draft before then. A property owner asked for a hearing on repairs at 2C Street after a September 16th, 2026 joint site inspection.
discussion: Body works draft rules: Questions covered background checks by the operator, appeals of fines to the municipal hearing officer, and why the age of 18 was not in brackets, with feedback still pending.

2C Street repair deadlines: The owner and tenant spoke about funding, the roof, plumbing, and smoke detectors. A 30-day extension for seven items was discussed, along with a follow-up inspection to check the smoke detectors.

Social consumption rules: Members raised concerns about enforcement, impaired driving, and who would check compliance. They said the city council has not asked the board for its input and discussed inviting the City Council president to a future meeting.
